map.欺诈构成退一赔三：赔偿金额 = 商品价款或服务费用 × 3，不足 500 元的按: Fraud gives a refund plus triple damages: compensation = price of the goods or service × 3, with a floor of ¥500; selling goods known to be defective brings actual-loss compensation under the Product Quality Law; food failing safety standards gives tenfold damages = price × 10, with a floor of ¥1,000.
map.明知缺陷致人伤亡: Death or injury from a known defect
map.经营者明知有缺陷: The seller knew of the defect
map.📋 消法赔偿规则: 📋 Compensation Rules under the Consumer Law
map.经营者提供商品或者服务有欺诈行为的，应当按照消费者的要求增加赔偿其受到的损失，增: Where a business commits fraud in supplying goods or services, it shall, at the consumer's request, pay additional compensation for the loss equal to three times the price paid for the goods or the cost of the service; where that amount is under ¥500, it is ¥500
map.生产不符合食品安全标准的食品或者经营明知是不符合食品安全标准的食品，消费者除要求: Where food failing safety standards is produced, or food known to fail them is sold, the consumer may claim compensation for the loss and also demand ten times the price or three times the loss from the producer or seller; where that amount is under ¥1,000, it is ¥1,000 (Article 148 of the Food Safety Law)
map.经营者明知商品或者服务存在缺陷，仍然向消费者提供，造成消费者或者其他受害人死亡或: Where a business knowingly supplies defective goods or services causing death or serious harm to health, the victim may claim compensation under Articles 49 and 51 and may also claim punitive damages of up to twice the loss suffered
map.📚 深度解析：消费者退一赔三计算器: 📚 In-depth: Consumer Refund plus Triple Damages
map.买到假冒伪劣商品，按《消费者权益保护法》第 55 条计算「退一赔三」的赔偿金额。: After buying counterfeit or substandard goods, compute the refund plus triple damages under Article 55 of the Consumer Rights Protection Law.
map.价款三倍不足 500 元的，按 500 元保底赔偿。: Where three times the price is under ¥500, a floor of ¥500 applies.
map.食品类欺诈适用「退一赔十」且不足 1000 元按 1000 元保底（食安法）。: Food fraud attracts a refund plus tenfold damages with a ¥1,000 floor under the Food Safety Law.
map.普通商品退一赔三: Refund plus triple for ordinary goods
map.购假货价款 2000 元，赔偿 = 2000 × 3 = 6000 元，加上退货: Fake goods bought for ¥2,000: damages = 2000 × 3 = ¥6,000, plus the refund gives ¥8,000 in total; when the price is only ¥100, the ¥500 floor applies.
map.购买不符合安全标准的食品价款 200 元，赔偿 = 200 × 10 = 200: Food failing safety standards bought for ¥200: damages = 200 × 10 = ¥2,000 (floor ¥1,000); personal injury may additionally support three times the loss.
map.退一赔三和退一赔十怎么选？: Which applies, refund plus triple or refund plus tenfold?
map.普通消费欺诈适用消法「退一赔三、保底 500」；食品领域明知不符合安全标准仍经营: Ordinary consumer fraud follows the Consumer Law rule of refund plus triple with a ¥500 floor; for food knowingly sold while failing safety standards, the Food Safety Law gives refund plus tenfold with a ¥1,000 floor. Each applies in its own situation.
map.需要证明经营者「明知」吗？: Must I prove the seller knew?
map.退一赔三一般只要证明欺诈（虚假宣传、售假）即可；食安法十倍赔偿对「明知」有要求，: Refund plus triple generally requires proof of fraud (false advertising, selling fakes). The tenfold food claim requires knowledge, which evidence such as labelling or sourcing can help establish; the court decides on the facts.
